Photography

Type

Newsreader by Production Type, and Hanken Grotesk by Alfredo Marco Pradil — both under the SIL Open Font License. Self-hosted here so the site does not call Google Fonts.

Code

If you add a photograph or a typeface, add the credit here as well as in the content.
